turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, books inside the bag. Today we will do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven, everyone write it in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, thirty five is wrong. You cannot take small from big like that. Answer is twenty five. Say it, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, again thirty five? I told you na, we borrow from the tens. We borrow from the tens! Two becomes twelve, five becomes four. Borrow from the tens!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Mina, stop counting on fingers, you are getting twenty six. Wrong. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Answer is twenty five. Who got twenty five? Thumbs up.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, next sum. Sixty three minus thirty eight. Do it quickly, no talking.
turns.label: new_sum
